title: anemone hortensis subsp. stellata
intro: Anemone hortensis subsp. stellata, commonly known as Wood Anemone or Stellata Wood Anemone, is a perennial plant belonging to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties that aid in the relief of pain, fever reduction, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Anemone hortensis subsp. stellata include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, analgesia, and antiviral activities. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its use in traditional medicine for its antiseptic, antiviral, and antifungal properties, which are believed to help in the treatment of various health conditions.
